alerts.title: Successful SSH login after repeated failures
alerts.description: User 'analyst' successfully authenticated from 192.0.2.44 after 3 failures within 10 minutes. This is a correlation signal, not proof of compromise.
recommended_actions: Contact the account owner and validate the successful login.
Review the resulting session, commands, and privilege changes.
Contain the source and reset credentials if the login is unauthorized.

alerts.title: Repeated SSH authentication failures
alerts.description: 5 failed SSH logins from 203.0.113.10 occurred within 5 minutes.
recommended_actions: Validate whether the source address is expected.
Review the targeted accounts and adjacent authentication events.
Block or rate-limit the source if the activity is unauthorized.

alerts.title: Possible SSH password spraying
alerts.description: 198.51.100.25 failed authentication against 4 distinct accounts within 10 minutes.
recommended_actions: Confirm whether the source is an approved scanner or jump host.
Check the targeted accounts for later successful authentication.
Review MFA, lockout, and source-blocking controls.
